title: Pivot from Asia? What Trump’s South Korea ‘shock’ says about US strategy
author: Michael Koziol
text:
AdvertisementAdd us as a preferred source on Google Listen to this article 9 min AdvertisementElbridge Colby, the Pentagon policy chief, has just completed a tour of South-east Asia where he tried to assure America’s allies that the US is still with them and dissuade them from pursuing a “middle power” strategy that excludes Washington and its weapons industry.It was undercut just days later when US President Donald Trump announced – via a social media post – that he was ordering the Pentagon to scale down joint military exercises with South Korea.
